'''Noncommutative measure and integration''' refers to the theory of [[Von Neumann algebras#Weights.2C states.2C and traces|weights, states, and traces]] on [[von Neumann algebra]]s (Takesaki 1979 v.&nbsp;2 p.&nbsp;141).

==References==
*I. E. Segal. A noncommutative extension of abstract integration. Ann. of Math. (2), 57:401–457, 1953. MR # 14:991f, JSTOR collection. 2.0(2)
*{{citation|first=R.P.|last=Kostecki |year=2013|arxiv=1307.4818|title=W*-algebras and noncommutative integration|bibcode=2013arXiv1307.4818P}}.
